attributes.name: Gallivance
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6+1; you may additionally discard this card or bury another card to add your Arcane skill. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

If you have the Magus trait, recharge this card to succeed at your check against a spell.
